message.content: Trade helps them. It gives them wealth. They use it to strengthen him. He controls it, and his power grows. She may support it, but they depend on it. We see that it rewards us. You observe that it binds them to him. Their allies trust him, and their enemies fear him. They send their goods abroad, and they bring foreign goods home. They pay their taxes, and they gain their benefits. He uses their loyalty to secure his throne. We know that their stability depends on it. If they lose it, they weaken; if they keep it, they thrive. They remember that trade, in their hands, makes their pharaoh more powerful, and it makes their empire endure.
